reasons.plausibility: Al is known to form intermetallics with refractory elements and destabilize the BCC phase, making retention of a single-phase BCC structure and high strength at 1000 °C highly unlikely without evidence.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and includes a specific rejection criterion (>10% drop in strength/ductility or loss of BCC phase), but the exact composition and processing are not fully specified.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis addresses the core question of density reduction but proposes a well-known problematic alloying strategy (Al addition) without citing supporting evidence, limiting its practical value.
